method.zh: 本頁為 sourceBased 官方比賽報導分析，逐場核對 ITTF 報導的結果、選手賽後說法與明述戰術；本輪未觀看比賽影片。日期指比賽日，與網頁發布或更新日分開。優勢與風險只適用於列出的情境；對戰問題是分析建議，不是量測結論。不同年份的勝負不能單獨證明動作改變，也不直接換算勝率。成都混合團體單打按三局累計團體分數，團體先達八分即結束，不能與七局四勝制混算。未取得逐板資料，故不提供球速、旋轉量、出手比例或關節角度。
method.en: This is sourceBased analysis of official match reports. Results, player testimony and explicitly reported tactics were checked against ITTF coverage; no match footage was watched in this research round. Dates are match dates, separate from page publication or updates. Strengths and risks are conditional on the listed situations; matchup questions are proposed analyses, not measured findings. Results across years alone cannot establish motion changes or win probabilities. Chengdu singles contribute game points across up to three scheduled games; a tie ends at eight game points. This format must be separated from best-of-seven matches. No stroke-level speed, spin, usage-rate or joint-angle measurements are available.

intro.zh: 王楚欽的研究重點是主動壓迫如何建立，以及接發受阻時能否重新組織。三場報導涵蓋巴黎失利、多哈決賽與澳門逆轉，適合比較不同對手帶來的問題。
intro.en: For Wang Chuqin, examine how pressure is established and how he reorganizes when receive becomes difficult. The Paris defeat, Doha final and Macao comeback expose different opponent problems.

strengths.zh: 多哈的組合值得學習：先用有質量的上旋限制站位，再把落點送到正反手轉換區；力量和位置共同起作用。
strengths.en: The Doha lesson is to combine topspin quality with the crossover placement, linking pressure on position to pressure on stroke selection.

strengths.zh: 澳門決賽顯示他能在落後局數時完成調整，應把比分與心理管理納入評估。
strengths.en: The Macao final demonstrates recovery while behind in games; score management and composure belong in the evaluation.

vulnerabilities.zh: 巴黎賽後本人指出，未充分回應對手發球變化；接發判斷是當場可確認的風險。
vulnerabilities.en: After Paris, Wang identified insufficient responses to serve changes. Receive adaptation was a documented risk in that match.

vulnerabilities.zh: 高排名不能保證搶先進攻。測試對手能否以發球擾亂第一板，比直接假設某一側有弱點更有證據依據。
vulnerabilities.en: Ranking does not guarantee initiative. Test whether serve variation disrupts his first response before assigning a permanent weak wing.

finding.zh: 王楚欽在賽後承認，對發球變化的應對不足。這是本人對本場的解釋，不能延伸成所有比賽的接發弱點。
finding.en: Wang attributed this defeat partly to inadequate responses to serve variation. His explanation concerns this match, not every receive situation.

matches.title: Day 5 of Table Tennis at Paris 2024: Truls Moregard Stops World Number 1

matches.event: World Championships Finals Doha 2025 — MS final

finding.zh: 報導明述正手重上旋逼退對手，追身球造成轉換猶豫；可確認的核心是限制對方組織進攻。
finding.en: The report describes heavy forehand topspin pushing Calderano back and crossover placement creating indecision, restricting his offensive organization.

matches.title: Japanese Duo Ends 64-Year Men's Doubles Drought While Wang Chuqin Becomes the New Men's Singles World Champion

finding.zh: 決賽先受壓再連取兩局；本人談到更能管理情緒與比賽。文章沒有足夠逐板描述解釋逆轉的技術手段。
finding.en: Wang won the last two games and discussed improved emotional and match management. The report does not identify the stroke-level mechanism of the comeback.

matches.title: Wang Chuqin Finally Claims His Crown: World Number One Wins First World Cup Title in Macao

finding.zh: 巴黎的接發困難與澳門的逆轉、心理管理說法可並列。多哈提供中間時點的明確壓迫方案；尚不能據此聲稱反手或發球動作已改造。
finding.en: The Paris receive difficulty and Macao recovery can be compared alongside his testimony. Doha supplies a documented pressure plan between them, without establishing a redesigned backhand or service motion.

limits.zh: 對手、賽制與場景不同；沒有相同來球的跨年逐板樣本。
limits.en: Opponents and contexts differ; no matched incoming-ball samples were analyzed across years.

matchupKeys.zh: 觀察接發變化能否阻止他建立連續壓迫。
matchupKeys.en: Examine whether receive variation interrupts sustained pressure.

matchupKeys.zh: 分開記錄追身球與大角度球造成的回球質量。
matchupKeys.en: Separate return quality against crossover and wide placement.

limits.zh: 左手橫拍是基本資料；本文不估計出手頻率。澳門比賽日依官方賽程結束日核對，文章頁面的更新日期不當成賽事日期。
limits.en: Left-handed shakehand is basic player metadata; no stroke frequencies are estimated. The Macao final date was checked against the official event schedule rather than the article's updated date.

intro.zh: 樊振東可以從「接住進攻後怎樣拿回主動」來研究。2019 年兩場報導呈現接發與相持的不同結果，2024 年巴黎則補上落後時調整節奏的本人說法。
intro.en: Study how Fan Zhendong recovers initiative after absorbing attack. Two 2019 reports contrast receive and rally outcomes; his Paris 2024 testimony adds rhythm adjustment under pressure.

strengths.zh: 總決賽的反手控制能接續反擊，落點同時威脅兩側，顯示防守回球也能改變對手站位。
strengths.en: His Grand Finals backhand control led into counters targeting both wings, showing that a defensive response can alter the opponent's position.

strengths.zh: 對張本的巴黎逆轉支持比賽中重新調整節奏的能力，而非每次都靠開局強攻。
strengths.en: The Paris comeback against Harimoto supports in-match rhythm adjustment, rather than dependence on dominating the opening.

vulnerabilities.zh: 巴黎本人承認開局主動不足；面對準備充分的對手，先失去節奏有實際代價。
vulnerabilities.en: Fan acknowledged insufficient initiative at the start in Paris. Losing rhythm against a well-prepared opponent had a clear cost.

vulnerabilities.zh: 瑞典賽林高遠在樊的發球分表現有效；需要檢查發球後第一板，不能只評估相持力量。
vulnerabilities.en: Lin Gaoyuan was effective on Fan's service points in Sweden. Examine the next stroke after service, not only rally strength.

matches.event: ITTF World Tour Swedish Open 2019 — MS semifinal

finding.zh: 報導特別指出林高遠在對手發球分有效。這提供前三板的檢查方向，未交代是哪一種發球被破解。
finding.en: The report highlights Lin's effectiveness on Fan's service points. It suggests examining the first three strokes but does not identify a specific serve being neutralized.

matches.title: Final Day: 2019 ITTF World Tour Swedish Open

matches.event: ITTF World Tour Grand Finals 2019 — MS final

finding.zh: 官方報導描述樊從反手控制馬龍的進攻，再以兩側大角度反擊；這是具體的攻防轉換證據。
finding.en: Official coverage describes backhand control of Ma's attacks followed by wide counters to both wings: a concrete attack-defense transition.

matches.title: Incredible form continues, Fan Zhendong yet again

finding.zh: 樊本人說開局主動不足，落後後沒有慌張，逐步調整節奏。報導未提供反手使用率或出手角度。
finding.en: Fan said he lacked early initiative, remained calm and adjusted his rhythm. The report supplies no backhand usage rate or stroke-angle measurements.

matches.title: Day 6 of Table Tennis at Paris 2024: Felix's Parisian Dream Continues, Fan Zhendong Survives in Seven

title.zh: 2019–2024：可比較應變，不能推定改了動作
title.en: 2019–2024: adaptation is comparable, motion changes are unproven

finding.zh: 2019 決賽有反手控制轉反擊的細節，2024 有節奏調整的自述；兩者支持應變能力，但描述層次不同，不能推算反手比例上升或站位更近台。
finding.en: The 2019 final details countering; the 2024 account describes rhythm adjustment. Both support adaptability, but cannot establish increased backhand usage or a closer stance.

limits.zh: 缺少可比的來球、擊球時點與站位資料。
limits.en: Comparable incoming-ball, contact-time and position data are missing.

matchupKeys.zh: 把發球後第一板與已進入相持的回合分開。
matchupKeys.en: Separate the first response after service from established rallies.

matchupKeys.zh: 測試改變落點能否阻止其從控制轉成反擊。
matchupKeys.en: Test whether placement changes interrupt his transition from control to counter.

limits.zh: 右手橫拍；列出的風險皆為特定場次問題，並非長期弱點排名。勝負不能單獨證明某一項力量或技術較弱。
limits.en: Right-handed shakehand. These risks concern particular matches, not a ranking of permanent weaknesses. Results alone cannot establish inferior power or technique.

intro.zh: 馬龍的可學之處是先讀對手，再選擇接發與銜接方式。2019 年對許昕的報導有明確的台內方案；同屆決賽與 2024 澳門則提醒，戰術控制仍會受對手與比分壓力考驗。
intro.en: Ma Long offers a lesson in reading an opponent before selecting receive and transitions. The 2019 Xu Xin report provides a specific over-table plan; that final and Macao 2024 show the constraints of opponent and score pressure.

strengths.zh: 對許昕交替使用追身下旋接發與送正手的擰接，讓短球控制服務於下一板，而非每球選同一動作。
strengths.en: Against Xu, body-directed backspin receives and a forehand-directed flick served the next stroke, rather than a single fixed receive choice.

strengths.zh: 澳門從 0–3 到 4–3，支持在極大比分壓力下繼續重組比賽的能力。
strengths.en: The Macao recovery from 0–3 to 4–3 demonstrates continued reorganization under severe score pressure.

vulnerabilities.zh: 樊振東能控制馬龍進攻後把球送往兩側；當下一板回球帶角度，連續進攻所需的還原時間會受考驗。
vulnerabilities.en: Fan controlled Ma's attacks and countered wide to both wings; angled replies tested the recovery needed to sustain offense.

vulnerabilities.zh: 對許昕曾連失兩局、對林高遠先失三局，不能把熟悉對手等同始終掌握節奏。
vulnerabilities.en: Two consecutive games lost to Xu and the early deficit against Lin show that familiarity does not guarantee rhythm control.

matches.event: ITTF World Tour Grand Finals 2019 — MS semifinal

finding.zh: 追身下旋接發先建立優勢，再用台內反手擰球改送正手。報導也明述較早擊球建立正手節奏。
finding.en: Body-directed backspin receives established an advantage; an over-table backhand flick then switched to the forehand. The report also describes early contact establishing forehand rhythm.

matches.title: The dragon roars, masterclass secures final place

matches.event: ITTF World Tour Grand Finals 2019 — MS final

finding.zh: 樊的控制與大角度反擊使馬龍被迫調整。這場呈現主動進攻遭回擊的限制，不能概括成馬龍某一側永久較弱。
finding.en: Fan's control and wide counters forced Ma to adjust. This reveals limits when offense is countered, not a permanent weak wing.

matches.title: Incredible form continues, Fan Zhendong yet again

finding.zh: 官方記錄連取四局逆轉，本人談到這次勝利帶來信心。文章沒有詳細列出逆轉時的發接或動作改變。
finding.en: The report records four consecutive games and Ma's confidence boost. It does not specify the serve-receive or motion changes behind the recovery.

matches.title: The G.O.A.T is back: Ma Long secures third Men’s World Cup title

title.zh: 2019–2024：調整能力延續，動作變化未確認

finding.zh: 2019 有具體接發方案，2024 有成功逆轉；可以比較如何解決比賽問題，不能據此聲稱年長後固定縮短引拍或轉成反手主導。
finding.en: The 2019 receive plan and 2024 recovery support comparing problem-solving, not claims that age caused shorter preparation or backhand dominance.

limits.zh: 兩篇描述不同層面，尚缺同類來球的跨期動作觀察。
limits.en: The reports describe different levels of detail; matched stroke observations across eras are absent.

matchupKeys.zh: 先記錄他如何改變接發落點，再看第三板選擇。
matchupKeys.en: Track changes in receive placement before assessing third-ball selection.

matchupKeys.zh: 觀察對手的反擊角度如何影響連續進攻與還原。
matchupKeys.en: Examine how counter angles affect repeated attack and recovery.

limits.zh: 右手橫拍。報導支持策略選擇與比分過程，未量測步法速度、關節角度或各打法頻率；不把逆轉自動歸因於某一項技術。
limits.en: Right-handed shakehand. Reports support tactical choices and score sequences, without measuring footwork speed, joint angles or usage rates. No single technique is assumed to cause the comeback.

intro.zh: Calderano 的研究重點是提早擊球與節奏變化需要什麼空間，以及被逼退台後怎樣受到限制。2024–2026 的場次提供成功進攻與受壓兩種情境。
intro.en: For Calderano, examine the space required for early contact and pace variation, and the constraints when pushed away from the table. Matches from 2024–2026 provide successful and pressured contexts.

strengths.zh: 澳門決賽的提早擊球、變速與變落點是官方明述的方案，可用來研究怎樣打斷對方固定節奏。
strengths.en: Early contact, pace changes and placement variation are explicitly reported in the Macao final, supporting study of rhythm disruption.

strengths.zh: 巴黎八強直落四勝張禹珍，確認他能在重大賽事打出完整結果；比分本身不說明使用哪一板最多。
strengths.en: The straight-games Paris quarterfinal win establishes a strong major-event result, without revealing which stroke he used most.

vulnerabilities.zh: 多哈對王楚欽與倫敦對 Coton 都出現被逼離台、進攻節奏受限的報導；此情境值得優先分析。
vulnerabilities.en: Doha against Wang and London against Coton both describe displacement from the table and restricted rhythm, making this a useful analytical priority.

finding.zh: 官方報導確認直落四晉級。文章以結果為主，未提供足夠逐板技術細節來辨認致勝模式。
finding.en: Official coverage confirms a straight-games victory. It is predominantly a result report and does not identify a stroke-level winning pattern.

matches.title: Calderano Breaks New Ground: First Non-Asian, Non-European Table Tennis Semifinalist at the Olympics

result.zh: 勝 4–1；先失一局後連取四局

finding.zh: 報導明述較早擊球，以及速度、落點的變化打斷林詩棟節奏；可確認有多種節奏手段。
finding.en: The report explicitly attributes rhythm disruption to early contact and variation in pace and placement.

matches.title: Hugo Calderano Makes History, Sun Yingsha Retains Crown at ITTF Men's and Women's World Cup 2025

matches.event: World Championships Finals Doha 2025 — MS final

finding.zh: 對方的正手上旋與追身壓力限制其進攻；第三局仍曾取勝，不能把受壓等同完全沒有應變。
finding.en: Forehand topspin and crossover pressure restricted his offense. Winning game three also shows that pressure did not eliminate every response.

matches.title: Japanese Duo Ends 64-Year Men's Doubles Drought While Wang Chuqin Becomes the New Men's Singles World Champion

matches.event: World Team Championships London 2026 — men’s quarterfinal tie

result.zh: 個人負 0–3；巴西團體負法國 0–3
result.en: Lost singles 0–3; Brazil lost the tie 0–3

finding.zh: 官方指 Coton 以主動反手逼退 Calderano，不讓他建立節奏。這是另一位對手造成相似限制的例子。
finding.en: Official coverage describes aggressive Coton backhands pushing Calderano away and denying settled rhythm: another opponent producing a similar constraint.

matches.title: Semifinals Confirmed as Romania Steal the Show on Day 11 at London 2026

title.zh: 2024–2026：兩種情境，尚非動作演變證明
title.en: 2024–2026: contrasting contexts, not proof of motion evolution

finding.zh: 巴黎的強勢結果與澳門的具體變速方案不能直接量化成進步幅度。多哈與倫敦則支持「被逼退台時節奏受限」會在不同對手下發生。
finding.en: Paris results and Macao tactics cannot quantify improvement. Doha and London support recurrence of disrupted rhythm when different opponents push him back.

limits.zh: 沒有跨年擊球距離或球速分布；這是情境比較。
limits.en: No cross-year contact-distance or speed distributions were measured; this is a comparison of contexts.

matchupKeys.zh: 區分能提早擊球的回合與被壓到退台的回合。
matchupKeys.en: Separate rallies allowing early contact from those forcing retreat.

matchupKeys.zh: 測試主動反手或追身壓力會怎樣改變其節奏選擇。
matchupKeys.en: Test how aggressive backhands or crossover pressure alter his rhythm options.

limits.zh: 右手橫拍。世界杯日期採比賽日 4 月 20 日，非頁面更新日；未把四場樣本當成全體對手的勝率或固定弱點。
limits.en: Right-handed shakehand. The World Cup date is the April 20 match date, not the page update date. Four examples are not an overall win rate or proof of a permanent weakness.

intro.zh: Felix 的核心問題是如何壓縮對手準備時間。巴黎報導記錄旋轉與節奏變化，成都提供針對側身正手的明確發接方案；直拍只是基本資料，不能代替戰術證據。
intro.en: Felix's central question is how he compresses the opponent's preparation time. Paris coverage records spin and tempo variation; Chengdu provides a receive-and-service plan against a pivot forehand. Grip alone is not tactical evidence.

strengths.zh: 巴黎首輪的主動進攻配合旋轉、節奏變化，說明快速打法也可以包含速度差，而非每球同樣快。
strengths.en: Aggression with spin and tempo variation in the Paris opener shows that a fast approach can include changes of pace.

strengths.zh: 成都對 Ionescu 的快發、銳利接發限制側身正手，體現前三板直接服務於對手特點。
strengths.en: Quick service and sharp receive against Ionescu restricted his pivot forehand, connecting the first three strokes to an opponent-specific plan.

vulnerabilities.zh: 巴黎曾讓 Ovtcharov 從 0–3 追成 3–3；取得開局優勢後仍需處理對手調整，不能把快速攻勢視為必然持續。
vulnerabilities.en: Ovtcharov recovered from 0–3 to 3–3 in Paris. An opening advantage still required handling adaptation; fast offense did not guarantee continued control.

vulnerabilities.zh: 報導未指出固定較弱的一側。對戰分析應先測試如何延長對方準備時間，避免以直拍身分臆測弱點。
vulnerabilities.en: The reports do not identify a permanent weaker wing. Analyze ways to gain preparation time rather than infer weakness from penhold grip.

finding.zh: 官方明述進攻、旋轉與節奏變化讓 Desai 難以進入節奏；未給出反手比例或球速。
finding.en: Coverage describes aggression and variation in spin and tempo preventing Desai from settling, without backhand usage or speed measurements.

matches.title: Table Tennis at Paris 2024: The Parisian Party Continues on Day 2

result.en: Won 4–3 after a 3–0 lead was erased

finding.zh: 決勝局取勝；本人談到壓力與關鍵分。比分顯示對手成功延長比賽，未交代哪項技術造成追平。
finding.en: Felix won the decider and discussed pressure and key points. The comeback lengthened the match, but its technical cause is not specified.

matches.title: Day 5 of Table Tennis at Paris 2024: Truls Moregard Stops World Number 1

matches.event: Mixed Team World Cup Chengdu 2025 — Stage 1, France v Romania

result.en: Won three fixed singles games 3–0; France won the tie 8–6

finding.zh: 快速發球與銳利接發使 Ionescu 忙於應對，沒有時間側身用招牌正手。這是報導明述的戰術關係。
finding.en: Quick serves and sharp receives rushed Ionescu and denied time for his signature step-around forehand: an explicitly reported tactical relationship.

matches.title: Day 3 Recap: Stage 1 Concludes in Style as Eight Teams Remain in the Hunt

title.zh: 2024–2025：共同的時間壓力，動作變化待核
title.en: 2024–2025: shared time pressure; motion changes unconfirmed

finding.zh: 巴黎描述節奏與旋轉，成都描述限制側身的發接。共同點是破壞對手準備；兩場尚不足以說明擰接比例增加、引拍縮短或反手結構改變。
finding.en: Paris describes spin and tempo; Chengdu describes service and receive restricting the pivot. Both disrupt preparation, but do not establish more flicks, shorter preparation or a changed backhand structure.

limits.zh: 對手與賽制不同，沒有相同來球下的動作比較。
limits.en: Opponents and formats differ; no matched-ball motion comparison is available.

matchupKeys.zh: 檢查發接速度是否讓對手來不及完成側身。
matchupKeys.en: Check whether service and receive speed prevent a completed pivot.

matchupKeys.zh: 分開分析開局搶節奏與對手調整後的相持。
matchupKeys.en: Separate opening rhythm pressure from rallies after opponent adjustment.

limits.zh: 右手直拍。成都單打以三局累計團體分數，團體達八分可提前結束；不可與巴黎七局四勝直接比較。本輪未看片或量測直拍反手動作。
limits.en: Right-handed penhold. Chengdu singles contribute game points over three scheduled games, with early completion when a team reaches eight; they cannot be directly compared with Paris best-of-seven. No footage or penhold-backhand motion was measured in this round.
